RHS 100.name: Introduction to Disability Culture
RHS 100.description: Increases student awareness of personal, interpersonal, and societal aspects of disability.

RHS 300.name: Introduction to Rehabilitation and Human Services
RHS 300.description: Introduction to practice settings, professional standards, and generalist practice models, with emphasis on assisting individuals with disabilities.

RHS 301.name: Introduction to Counseling as a Profession
RHS 301.description: Overview of counseling theories used in human service and rehabilitation practices.

RHS 302.name: Client Assessment in Rehabilitation and Human Services
RHS 302.description: Overview of rehabilitation and health-related assessments, psychometrics, and multicultural test fairness considerations.

RHS 303.name: Group Work in Rehabilitation Practice and Human Services
RHS 303.description: Foundational understanding of group dynamics and team-related activities in rehabilitation settings. Bulletin recommends 6 credits in psychology, sociology, or related fields (not enforced).

RHS 400W.name: Case Management and Communication Skills
RHS 400W.description: Principles for obtaining, recording, evaluating case data and implementing rehabilitation plans. Writing Across the Curriculum.

RHS 401.name: Community Mental Health Practice and Services
RHS 401.description: Issues specific to therapeutic helping in community mental health settings, recovery principles, and evidence-based practices. Bulletin also requires 4th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

RHS 402.name: Children and Families in Rehabilitation Settings and Human Services
RHS 402.description: Family issues, child development, legal and cultural factors in rehabilitation practice.

RHS 403.name: Medical Aspects of Disability
RHS 403.description: Overview of chronic illnesses and disabilities, their lifespan impact, and appropriate rehabilitation accommodations. Bulletin also requires 4th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

RHS 493.name: Professional Development and Internship Preparation in RHS
RHS 493.description: Preparation for internship experiences and career planning, including human development theories and professional dispositions.

RHS 495A.name: Rehabilitation and Human Services Internship
RHS 495A.description: Practical internship in rehabilitation agencies providing services to individuals with disabilities. Catalog lists a 6-12cr range; modeled here at 9cr as a representative value for this capstone term.
